# Execution quality – daily TCA

Change the **`day`** variable (Variables button, e.g. `'2026-11-12'`) to rerun every cell. Markouts use the quote feed of the venue each fill traded on; **positive = the market moved in our favour**. Exchange fills come from `energy_fills`; OTC/broker trades from `energy_trade_events` (the only real counterparties). USD = px_factor × the day's average EURUSD/GBPUSD.

**11 Nov 2026:** (1) No systematic picking off. (2) NBP passive offers lifted 09:19–09:37, ahead of a market-wide gas/power shock (front months +6–7.6%, 09:30–09:50): about −$240k at 30 min. That's position risk, not toxic flow. (3) trader_01 bought 3.33M bbl of BRENT_Jan-27 between 07:00 and 07:30: about $415k of price impact, and CRUDE/BRENT over its 2M bbl limit from 07:21 to 08:27, including OTC trades. (4) trader_11 put a manual TTF_Q1-27 mark about 300 bps above market from 08:00 to 08:29. (5) Model champion_v1 stopped tracking winter contracts after the shock: −385 to −514 bps bias. (6) Start-of-day snapshots are built on booking date, and 34 trades done on the 11th were booked on the 12th, so 39 book/symbol positions are wrong on a trade-date basis. (7) OTC booking lag averages 5.4 h. About 25% of passive gas/power fills print through the far touch of a stale feed.

SELECT h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_sec,
  avg(CASE WHEN t.passive THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END) AS passive_bps,
  avg(CASE WHEN NOT t.passive THEN sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000 END) AS aggressive_bps,
  avg((q.ask-q.bid)/((q.ask+q.bid)/2)*10000/2) AS half_spread_bps
FROM energy_fills t
HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
LIST (-300s, -60s, -10s, 0, 1s, 10s, 30s, 60s, 120s, 300s, 600s, 1800s) AS h
WHERE t.ts IN @day
ORDER BY horizon_sec
cells.name: Markout curve (bps) – passive vs aggressive vs half-spread

WITH hz AS (
  SELECT timestamp_floor('h', t.ts) AS hour, t.symbol, t.passive, count() AS n,
    sum(t.qty * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px)) AS pnl_ccy
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (1800s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day
), fx AS (
  SELECT symbol AS fx_symbol, avg((bid+ask)/2) AS usd FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD')
), u AS (
  SELECT hz.hour, hz.passive, hz.pnl_ccy * i.px_factor * coalesce(fx.usd, 1.0) AS pnl_usd
  FROM hz JOIN energy_instruments i ON i.symbol = hz.symbol LEFT JOIN fx ON fx.fx_symbol = i.fx_symbol
)
SELECT hour, round(sum(CASE WHEN passive THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS passive_usd_30m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN NOT passive THEN pnl_usd ELSE 0 END)) AS aggressive_usd_30m
FROM u GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
cells.name: 30-min markout P&L by hour of fill (USD)

cells.value:
WITH hz AS (
  SELECT t.symbol, t.curve, t.passive, h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n,
    sum(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS sum_bps,
    sum(power(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000, 2)) AS sum_bps2,
    sum(t.qty * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px)) AS pnl_ccy,
    sum(abs(t.qty) * t.px) AS notional_ccy
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (0, 60s, 300s, 1800s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day
), fx AS (
  SELECT symbol AS fx_symbol, avg((bid+ask)/2) AS usd FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD')
), usd AS (
  SELECT hz.curve, hz.passive, hz.horizon_sec, hz.n, hz.sum_bps, hz.sum_bps2,
    hz.pnl_ccy * i.px_factor * coalesce(fx.usd, 1.0) AS pnl_usd,
    hz.notional_ccy * i.px_factor * coalesce(fx.usd, 1.0) AS notional_usd
  FROM hz JOIN energy_instruments i ON i.symbol = hz.symbol
  LEFT JOIN fx ON fx.fx_symbol = i.fx_symbol
), g AS (
  SELECT curve, passive, horizon_sec, sum(n) AS n, sum(sum_bps) AS sb, sum(sum_bps2) AS sb2,
    sum(pnl_usd) AS pnl_usd, sum(notional_usd) AS notional_usd
  FROM usd GROUP BY curve, passive, horizon_sec
), s AS (
  SELECT curve, passive, horizon_sec, n, notional_usd, pnl_usd, sb / n AS mo_bps,
    sqrt((sb2 - sb * sb / n) / (n - 1)) AS sd_bps
  FROM g
)
SELECT curve, CASE WHEN passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity,
  max(n) AS fills, round(max(notional_usd) / 1e6, 1) AS notional_musd,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_0s,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 60 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_1m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_5m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_30m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo_bps / (sd_bps / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_5m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS usd_0s,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS usd_5m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN pnl_usd END)) AS usd_30m
FROM s GROUP BY curve, passive ORDER BY usd_30m
cells.name: Scorecard by curve and liquidity (markout bps, t-stat, USD)

WITH b AS (
  SELECT ts, symbol, close, first_value(close) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY ts) AS day_open
  FROM energy_quotes_1m
  WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol IN ('NBP_Dec-26', 'TTF_Jan-27', 'UKPWR_Jan-27', 'BRENT_Jan-27', 'GASOIL_Dec-26')
)
SELECT ts, symbol, round((close / day_open - 1) * 100, 3) AS pct_vs_open FROM b ORDER BY ts

WITH per AS (
  SELECT t.ts, t.symbol, t.venue, t.book, t.trader, t.passive, t.qty, t.px, (q.bid+q.ask)/2 AS mid_30m
  FROM energy_fills t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
  LIST (1800s) AS h
  WHERE t.ts IN @day
), fx AS (
  SELECT symbol AS fx_symbol, avg((bid+ask)/2) AS usd FROM energy_quotes
  WHERE ts IN @day AND symbol IN ('EURUSD', 'GBPUSD')
)
SELECT per.ts, per.symbol, per.venue, per.book, per.trader,
  CASE WHEN per.passive THEN 'passive' ELSE 'aggressive' END AS liquidity,
  per.qty, per.px, per.mid_30m,
  round(sign(per.qty) * (per.mid_30m - per.px) / per.px * 10000, 1) AS markout_30m_bps,
  round(per.qty * (per.mid_30m - per.px) * i.px_factor * coalesce(fx.usd, 1.0)) AS markout_30m_usd
FROM per JOIN energy_instruments i ON i.symbol = per.symbol
LEFT JOIN fx ON fx.fx_symbol = i.fx_symbol
ORDER BY markout_30m_usd LIMIT 20
cells.name: Worst fills by 30-min markout (USD)

WITH sod AS (
  SELECT book, curve, sum(qty) AS sod_qty FROM energy_position_snapshots WHERE ts IN @day GROUP BY book, curve
), ev AS (
  SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts >= @day::timestamp LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id
), u AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT ts::timestamp AS ts, book, curve, qty FROM energy_fills WHERE ts IN @day
    UNION ALL
    SELECT trade_ts AS ts, book, curve, qty FROM ev WHERE status != 'CANCELLED' AND channel != 'EXCH' AND trade_ts IN @day
  ) ORDER BY ts
), r AS (
  SELECT ts, book, curve, sum(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY book, curve ORDER BY ts CUMULATIVE) AS traded FROM u
), p AS (
  SELECT r.ts, r.book, r.curve, r.traded + coalesce(sod.sod_qty, 0) AS pos FROM r LEFT JOIN sod ON sod.book = r.book AND sod.curve = r.curve
)
SELECT p.book, p.curve, l.max_abs_qty AS limit_qty, l.unit,
  max(abs(p.pos)) AS peak_abs_position,
  round(100.0 * max(abs(p.pos)) / l.max_abs_qty, 1) AS peak_pct_of_limit,
  min(CASE WHEN abs(p.pos) > l.max_abs_qty THEN p.ts END) AS first_breach,
  max(CASE WHEN abs(p.pos) > l.max_abs_qty THEN p.ts END) AS last_breach
FROM p JOIN energy_limits l ON l.book = p.book AND l.curve = p.curve
GROUP BY p.book, p.curve, l.max_abs_qty, l.unit ORDER BY peak_pct_of_limit DESC
cells.name: Position limit check (start-of-day + exchange + OTC/broker, trade-date)

WITH m AS (
  SELECT t.counterparty, t.channel, h.offset / 1000000 AS horizon_sec, count() AS n,
    avg(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS mo_bps,
    stddev_samp(sign(t.qty) * ((q.bid+q.ask)/2 - t.px) / t.px * 10000) AS sd_bps
  FROM ((SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND status = 'NEW' AND channel != 'EXCH' ORDER BY trade_ts) timestamp(trade_ts)) t
  HORIZON JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol)
  LIST (0, 300s, 1800s) AS h
)
SELECT counterparty, channel, max(n) AS trades,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 0 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_0s,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 300 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_5m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN mo_bps END), 2) AS bps_30m,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN horizon_sec = 1800 THEN mo_bps / (sd_bps / sqrt(n)) END), 1) AS t_30m
FROM m GROUP BY counterparty, channel ORDER BY bps_30m
cells.name: OTC / broker counterparties – markout (bps, small n: read t-stat)

SELECT k.ts, k.symbol, k.source, k.version, k.marked_by, k.price,
  round((q.last_bid + q.last_ask) / 2, 3) AS market_mid,
  round((k.price / ((q.last_bid + q.last_ask) / 2) - 1) * 10000, 1) AS diff_bps
FROM energy_curve_marks k
LEFT JOIN energy_quotes_1m q ON q.symbol = k.symbol AND q.ts = k.ts
WHERE k.ts IN @day AND (k.source = 'MANUAL' OR k.version > 1)
ORDER BY k.ts, k.symbol, k.source
cells.name: Manual and restated curve marks vs market mid

WITH g AS (
  SELECT ts, model_version, season, err_bps FROM energy_model_graded_day WHERE bid IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT timestamp_floor('15m', ts) AS ts, model_version || ' ' || season AS model_season, round(avg(err_bps), 1) AS bias_bps
FROM g GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
cells.name: Model fair value bias vs market (bps), by model and season

WITH s0 AS (SELECT book, symbol, sum(qty) q FROM energy_position_snapshots WHERE ts IN @day GROUP BY book, symbol),
s1 AS (SELECT book, symbol, sum(qty) q FROM energy_position_snapshots WHERE ts IN interval(dateadd('d', 1, @day::timestamp), dateadd('u', -1, dateadd('d', 2, @day::timestamp))) GROUP BY book, symbol),
ev AS (SELECT * FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts >= dateadd('d', -3, @day::timestamp) LATEST ON booked_ts PARTITION BY trade_id),
fb AS (SELECT trade_id, min(booked_ts) AS first_booked FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts >= dateadd('d', -3, @day::timestamp) GROUP BY trade_id),
d AS (SELECT ev.book, ev.symbol, ev.qty, ev.trade_ts, fb.first_booked FROM ev JOIN fb ON fb.trade_id = ev.trade_id WHERE ev.status != 'CANCELLED'),
x AS (SELECT book, symbol,
   sum(CASE WHEN trade_ts IN @day THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS traded_on_day,
   sum(CASE WHEN first_booked IN @day THEN qty ELSE 0 END) AS booked_on_day
 FROM d GROUP BY book, symbol),
k AS (SELECT book, symbol FROM s0 UNION SELECT book, symbol FROM s1 UNION SELECT book, symbol FROM x)
SELECT k.book, k.symbol, coalesce(s0.q, 0) AS sod_day, coalesce(s1.q, 0) AS sod_next_day,
  coalesce(x.traded_on_day, 0) AS traded_on_day, coalesce(x.booked_on_day, 0) AS booked_on_day,
  coalesce(s1.q, 0) - coalesce(s0.q, 0) - coalesce(x.booked_on_day, 0) AS break_vs_booking_date,
  coalesce(s1.q, 0) - coalesce(s0.q, 0) - coalesce(x.traded_on_day, 0) AS break_vs_trade_date
FROM k LEFT JOIN s0 ON s0.book = k.book AND s0.symbol = k.symbol
LEFT JOIN s1 ON s1.book = k.book AND s1.symbol = k.symbol
LEFT JOIN x ON x.book = k.book AND x.symbol = k.symbol
WHERE abs(coalesce(s1.q, 0) - coalesce(s0.q, 0) - coalesce(x.traded_on_day, 0)) > 0.5
   OR abs(coalesce(s1.q, 0) - coalesce(s0.q, 0) - coalesce(x.booked_on_day, 0)) > 0.5
ORDER BY abs(break_vs_trade_date) DESC
cells.name: Position reconciliation: next-day snapshot vs booking-date and trade-date flows

cells.value:
WITH fb AS (SELECT trade_id, min(booked_ts) AS first_booked FROM energy_trade_events WHERE booked_ts >= @day::timestamp GROUP BY trade_id)
SELECT e.trade_ts, fb.first_booked, round(datediff('s', e.trade_ts, fb.first_booked) / 3600.0, 1) AS lag_h, e.channel, e.counterparty, e.book, e.trader, e.symbol, e.qty, e.px
FROM energy_trade_events e JOIN fb ON fb.trade_id = e.trade_id
WHERE e.trade_ts IN @day AND e.version = 1 AND timestamp_floor('d', fb.first_booked) > timestamp_floor('d', e.trade_ts)
ORDER BY lag_h DESC
cells.name: Trades booked on a later day than they were done

cells.value:
SELECT channel, count() AS trades,
  round(avg(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts)) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_booking_lag_min,
  round(max(datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts)) / 3600.0, 1) AS max_booking_lag_h,
  sum((datediff('s', trade_ts, booked_ts) > 3600)::int) AS booked_over_1h_late,
  sum((timestamp_floor('d', booked_ts) > timestamp_floor('d', trade_ts))::int) AS booked_next_day
FROM energy_trade_events WHERE trade_ts IN @day AND version = 1 GROUP BY channel ORDER BY avg_booking_lag_min DESC
cells.name: Ops check – booking latency by channel

SELECT ts, curve, symbol, delta_bucket, version, source, iv, tau
FROM energy_iv_marks WHERE ts IN @day AND version > 1 ORDER BY ts
cells.name: Data check – restated implied-vol marks

cells.value:
SELECT t.curve, t.venue, count() AS passive_fills,
  sum((CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN t.px < q.bid ELSE t.px > q.ask END)::int) AS through_far_touch,
  round(100.0 * sum((CASE WHEN t.qty > 0 THEN t.px < q.bid ELSE t.px > q.ask END)::int) / count(), 1) AS pct_through,
  round(avg((t.ts - q.ts) / 1e9), 1) AS avg_quote_age_s,
  round(max((t.ts - q.ts) / 1e9), 1) AS max_quote_age_s
FROM energy_fills t ASOF JOIN energy_quotes q ON (t.symbol = q.symbol AND t.venue = q.source)
WHERE t.ts IN @day AND t.passive
GROUP BY t.curve, t.venue ORDER BY pct_through DESC
cells.name: Data check – passive fills printed through the far touch

## Coverage (11 Nov 2026)

| Object | Checked | Result |
|---|---|---|
| energy_fills | markouts −30 s to 30 min by venue/curve/trader/hour/size, 10–12 Nov baseline, tick/lot, expiry, split orders | no picking off; Brent programme; NBP pre-shock offers |
| energy_quotes | gaps per hour, crossed books, staleness at fill | no gaps or crossed books; back months up to 917 s stale; EEX quote 1 ns before every EEX fill |
| energy_quotes_10s/1m/5m/1d | lineage, 1d close vs 1m last | consistent |
| energy_trade_events | channels, amendments, cancels, booking lag, counterparty markouts | 5.4 h OTC lag, 34 booked next day, one duplicate booking |
| energy_book_asof / _restated / trade_events_latest | @asof = end of 11th | 2,973 vs 3,007 rows: the 34 late trades. Defaults to today |
| energy_position_snapshots, energy_ledger | next-day reconciliation | booking-date basis; 39 trade-date breaks; ledger has no OTC |
| energy_positions_live(_by_venue) | vs fills | reset daily: traded-today, not position; matches fills |
| energy_positions_running_day | definition | traded-today, no start-of-day |
| energy_limits | running position vs limit | CRUDE/BRENT 147%, 07:21–08:27 |
| energy_curve_marks, _1h, _latest, marks_asof, marks_live | marks vs mid, manual, versions | manual TTF_Q1-27 mark +300 bps |
| energy_strip_gaps_day | gaps on 11th | only the manual mark (€2.50) |
| energy_model_prices, model_graded_day | bias by model/season/hour | champion_v1 winter −385 to −514 bps after 10:00 |
| energy_iv_marks | ranges, nulls, versions | TTF_Mar-27 ATM restated +8 vol pts, 10:30–10:45 |
| energy_settlements | vs last mid, volume | within 13 bps, fine |
| energy_da_prices | ranges, publication time | fine |
| energy_instruments, listings, instrument_master, tenors(_asof) | dupes, primary, expiry | fine; tenor views drop expired GASOIL_Nov-26 as of today |
| energy_fx_asof, usd_factor_asof | nulls, levels | fine |
| energy_lineage | status | all valid/active |
